title: 第3章 汝之道需自寻第4章 未生人心先生人性
content_zh:
突然，萧枫左侧地面猛地炸开，茅不易的身形如闪电迅速飞出，直扑他的面门！
月光下，那拳头大小、甲壳碧绿、挥舞着六肢的蜣螂，显得格外诡异。
“找死！”
萧枫暴喝一声，手中的清风剑回旋，剑光顿时织成一片青网，直奔茅不易而去。
感受着剑光形成的青网所散发出的强大灵气波动，茅不易顿时心生不妙。
“坏了！坏了！他实力怎么这么强，失策了！”
茅不易双翅猛的一震，一道轰鸣声随之响起，他居然以违背常理的速度瞬间坠地。
六足飞快扒拉地面，竟如同游鱼入水般，眼看就要再次钻入土中。
“想跑？”
萧枫剑诀一变，清风剑分化出三道剑影，封死了茅不易的所有退路。
最后一剑直取他的要害而来！
见避无可避！毛不易索性直接不避！
只见他蜷缩成一团，坚固的甲壳顿时将其包裹其中。
剑影划过漆黑的甲壳，却未留下半点痕迹。
“这么硬！”萧枫心中惊讶道。
就在他失神的这一刹那，茅不易抓住机会。
他借着碰撞之力向后弹开，随后钻入地底，消失不见。
看着四周的一片狼藉，萧枫眼中杀机暴涨。
他意识到，这不是一只普通的虫精，而是一个成长速度惊人的邪物！
“此獠……断不可留！”

地底深处，茅不易快速朝远方遁去。
其甲壳上残留的剑气虽未破开甲壳，但震得他内腑隐隐作痛。
他因为心中愤恨，双眼变得血红。
他意识到还需要吸收更多的灵球，才可以击杀那萧枫！
他翻找着李青松的记忆，关于青云宗地形、人物的信息出现在他的脑海之中。
一道信息吸引了他的注意，正是那将他曝出的那位女弟子的住所所在。
本着有仇不报非君子的原则，他来到了翠竹苑的一角。
房间内的陈雪正对镜梳妆，脸上带着一丝得意与后怕交织的复杂神色。
“幸亏我眼尖，发现了那虫精，及时上报……长老们定然记了我一功。”
她喃喃自语，随即又打了个寒颤。
“不过那虫精也当真可怕，竟能害了李师兄……”
茅不易方才吃了没有探查的亏后，便耐心了起来。
content_en:
Suddenly, the ground on Xiao Feng's left side suddenly exploded, and Mao Buyi's figure flew out quickly like lightning, heading straight for his face!
Under the moonlight, the fist-sized dung beetle, with a green carapace and waving six limbs, looked particularly strange.
"Seeking death!"
Xiao Feng roared loudly, whirling the Qingfeng Sword in his hand, and the sword light immediately weaved into a green net and went straight towards Mao Buyi.
Feeling the powerful spiritual energy fluctuations emitted by the green net formed by the sword light, Mao Buyi suddenly felt something bad.
"It's broken! It's broken! Why is he so strong? He made a mistake!"
Mao Buyi's wings shook violently, a roar followed, and he suddenly fell to the ground at a speed that defied common sense.
The six legs quickly pulled at the ground, just like a fish swimming in water, and it was about to sink into the soil again.
"Want to run?"
Xiao Feng's sword technique changed, and the Qingfeng Sword split into three sword shadows, blocking all Mao Buyi's escape routes.
The last sword came straight to his vital point!
There is no way to avoid it! Mao Buyi simply refused to avoid it!
He was seen curled up into a ball, and the strong carapace immediately wrapped him inside.
The shadow of the sword streaked across the pitch-black carapace, leaving no trace.
"So hard!" Xiao Feng was surprised.
At the moment when he was distracted, Mao Buyi seized the opportunity.
He bounced back with the force of the collision, then got into the ground and disappeared.
Looking at the mess around him, murderous intent surged in Xiao Feng's eyes.
He realized that this was not an ordinary insect spirit, but an evil creature that grew at an alarming rate!
"This beast... must not be kept!"
Deep underground, Mao Buyi quickly escaped into the distance.
Although the remaining sword energy on his carapace did not break through the carapace, it caused a dull pain in his insides.
His eyes turned blood red because of the resentment in his heart.
He realized that he needed to absorb more spirit balls before he could kill Xiao Feng!
He rummaged through Li Qingsong's memory, and information about the Qingyun Sect's terrain and characters appeared in his mind.
A piece of information attracted his attention, which was the residence of the female disciple who exposed him.
In line with the principle of not repaying a grudge without being a gentleman, he came to a corner of Cuizhu Garden.
In the room, Chen Xue was dressing up in front of the mirror, with a complex look of pride and fear on her face.
"Fortunately, I had sharp eyesight and discovered the bug spirit and reported it in time... The elders will definitely take note of me."
She muttered to herself, then shuddered again.
"But that insect spirit is really scary. It could actually harm Senior Brother Li..."
After Mao Buyi had just suffered the loss of not investigating, he became patient.
